prompt: Style & Mood: High-end 3D CG cutscene render, Unreal Engine 5 quality. Deep cosmic blacks, faint starlight, a single cold point of light. Volumetric nebula haze, ray-traced glints, cinematic depth of field. Rendered CG, not a photograph, not a 2D painting. Narrative Summary: Deep in the cosmos, a vast rift in space — the Void — reveals itself. Dynamic Description: A slow stabilized push-in drifts through absolute darkness toward a single distant point of light. As it approaches, the point widens into a vast vertical rift in space, a cosmic abyss of drifting rock and faint nebulae, threads of pale energy running down its center. A macro insert punches to a shard of dark crystal tumbling in the void, catching a glint of light, then a wide crane opens to reveal the full scale of the rift, pale energy pulsing from its depths and blooming softly toward the frame as the beat ends. Slow, majestic, weightless motion; awe and dread; the camera pushes in then cranes wide, never a flat zoom. Static Description: A vast vertical cosmic rift in deep space, drifting asteroids and dark crystal shards, faint nebula clouds, distant galaxies, threads of pale blue-violet energy.

风格与氛围：高端三维CG过场渲染，虚幻引擎5级别。深邃宇宙黑，微弱星光，一点孤冷光芒。体积星云薄雾，光线追踪微光，电影级景深。CG渲染，非照片，非二维绘画。叙事概要：宇宙深处，一道浩瀚的空间裂隙——虚空——徐徐显现。动态描述：缓慢稳定的推镜穿越绝对黑暗，推向一点遥远光芒。随着靠近，光点扩展为一道浩瀚的垂直空间裂隙，漂浮岩石与微弱星云构成的宇宙深渊，苍白能量丝线自其中央垂落。微距插入切至一枚在虚空中翻滚的暗色晶体碎片，映出一缕微光，随即摇臂展开为广角，揭示裂隙的全貌，苍白能量自深处搏动，向画面柔和绽放，段落收束。缓慢、庄严、失重的运动；敬畏与不安；镜头先推进再摇臂拉阔，绝非平直变焦。静态描述：深空中一道浩瀚的垂直宇宙裂隙，漂浮小行星与暗色晶体碎片，微弱星云，远方星系，苍白蓝紫能量丝线。
